subgoals.title: Windowsで安全な定期Goal受信を実行する
acceptanceCriteria: Create opt-in Windows Task Scheduler setup and removal scripts that use the existing Node.js receiver in the exact isolated Goal Queue workspace, without installing software or copying credentials.

The scheduled action must only invoke the existing one-shot receiver to validate and stage a new plan; it must never import goals, run Codex, alter the LIVE queue, auto-approve reviews or perform retries without bounds.

Provide offline checks for safe command construction, duplicate-schedule prevention, review-pending stop behavior and clean removal; test setup must not register a real scheduled task and all current regressions must continue passing.
